publication_revisions.abstract: Here we report the ATLAS discovery of the transient ATLAS26kqj (AT2026aabz) in galaxy ESO 580- G 014 at magnitude m_o = 18.44 +/- 0.20. At a distance of 88 Mpc, the transient was discovered on MJD = 61281.25 (2026-08-29.25) with an absolute magnitude of M = -16.5 +/- 0.2. The last non-detection (to 5 sigma, unforced) was on MJD = 61279.26. Forced photometry indicates that the transient is rising. Spectroscopic classification is encouraged.

publication_revisions.title: ATLAS26kqj (AT2026aabz): discovery of a candidate SN in ESO 580- G 014 (88 Mpc)

publications.abstract: Here we report the ATLAS discovery of the transient ATLAS26kqj (AT2026aabz) in galaxy ESO 580- G 014 at magnitude m_o = 18.44 +/- 0.20. At a distance of 88 Mpc, the transient was discovered on MJD = 61281.25 (2026-08-29.25) with an absolute magnitude of M = -16.5 +/- 0.2. The last non-detection (to 5 sigma, unforced) was on MJD = 61279.26. Forced photometry indicates that the transient is rising. Spectroscopic classification is encouraged.
